services.name: Free Trial Class
services.desc: Artworks is pleased to provide a complimentary introductory class for ages 6-17 across all our locations. Adults are also welcome to participate in an introductory class for a fee. These sessions provide a firsthand glimpse into the unique artistic experience Artworks offers, allowing you to explore before enrolling. No need to bring any materials for the introductory class - we’ve got you covered. We offer the free trial class only one time per student. Fill out the online registration form by clicking the button below. A form of payment is required; however, you WILL NOT be charged unless you decide to join. Be sure to select you would like it to be a trial class. Important: Trial class

explain.meaning: A first class to try it out before committing.

services.name: Pottery class
services.desc: Discover ceramics and pottery at Artworks Fine Art Studio in Potomac, Maryland. We offer hands-on classes for kids, teens, and adults, from beginners trying clay for the first time to students looking to build their skills. Learn wheel throwing, handbuilding, glazing, and more in our Potomac ceramics studio. Discover the joy of working with clay in our kids ceramics and pottery classes at Artworks Fine Art Studio in Potomac, Maryland. Designed for ages 8-12, these hands-on classes introduce young artists to the fundamentals of ceramics in a fun, supportive environment. Whether your child is brand new to pottery or has prior experience, our instructors will guide them at their own pace.

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Artworks offers summer camps for ages 6-17 across our three studio locations.Teen camps (ages 13-17) are offered in Bethesda only. At Artworks Fine Art Studio, summer is a time for creativity, confidence, and artistic growth. Our camps are designed to inspire young artists through drawing, painting, mixed media, sculpture, ceramics, and more in a welcoming studio environment. With small class sizes, age-appropriate instruction, and experienced teachers, campers receive personalized guidance while exploring new materials and techniques each week.
